links.outcome: Physician-plus-GPT-4 score compared with GPT-4 alone on management reasoning rubrics
links.effect: No significant difference between GPT-4-augmented physicians and GPT-4 alone (-0.9%, 95% CI -9.0 to 7.2, p=0.8), so standalone performance matched human-AI team performance.
links.quote: There was no significant difference between GPT-4-augmented physicians and GPT-4 alone (-0.9%, 95% CI -9.0 to 7.2, p=0.8).

screen.reason: The study is a randomized controlled trial assessing physician performance on clinical vignettes with versus without LLM assistance (GPT-4), testing AI assistance efficacy rather than a specific deployment safeguard or practice.
